note: Mathematics-Computer Science major (MA30). A math-CS major is not allowed to also minor in computer science in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering; CSE courses are subject to enrollment restrictions.

requirements.name_zh: 低年级：线性代数与微积分系列（二选一）

requirements.name_zh: 低年级：CSE 11 加速编程入门

requirements.name: Software Tools and Techniques Laboratory (one of)
requirements.name_zh: 低年级：软件工具实验（二选一）

requirements.name: Basic Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design (CSE 12)
requirements.name_zh: 低年级：CSE 12 数据结构与面向对象设计

requirements.name: Mathematical Reasoning (MATH 109)
requirements.note: Students completing MATH 31AH-BH-CH may substitute a four-unit upper-division mathematics elective for MATH 109.
requirements.note_zh: 修完 MATH 31AH-BH-CH 的学生可用一门 4 学分高年级数学选修课替代 MATH 109。

requirements.name_zh: 高年级：现代应用代数或现代代数（选一序列）

requirements.name: Theory of Computability (CSE 105)

requirements.note_zh: 修 CSE 105 之前须先修 CSE 21、MATH 100A、MATH 103A、MATH 184 或 MATH 184A 其中之一。

requirements.name: Computer Implementations of Data Structures (CSE 100)
requirements.note: CSE 21 or MATH 154 or MATH 184 or MATH 184A must be taken prior to CSE 100.
requirements.note_zh: 修 CSE 100 之前须先修 CSE 21、MATH 154、MATH 184 或 MATH 184A 其中之一。

requirements.note_zh: MATH 183 不是 MATH 181A 的先修课；MATH 180A/183 与 ECON 120A 存在学分重复。

requirements.name_zh: 高年级：离散数学或组合数学（四选一）

requirements.name_zh: 高年级：算法设计与分析（CSE 101）

requirements.name: Applied Mathematics Electives (8 units)
requirements.note: Eight units from the listed courses; a single course cannot fulfill more than one major requirement.
requirements.name_zh: 高年级：应用数学选修（8 学分）
requirements.note_zh: 从所列课程中修满 8 学分；单门课不能同时满足两条专业要求。

requirements.name: Computational Electives (8 units)
requirements.note: Eight units from the listed courses; a single course cannot fulfill more than one major requirement. Students interested in computer architecture courses (CSE 140-140L, 141-141L, 142) should take CSE 30 as preparation.
requirements.name_zh: 高年级：计算选修（8 学分）
requirements.note_zh: 从所列课程中修满 8 学分；单门课不能同时满足两条专业要求；想选计算机体系结构方向（CSE 140-140L、141-141L、142）建议先修 CSE 30。

requirements.name: General Math—CS Electives (8 units)
requirements.note: Eight additional units from the applied/computational elective lists or the listed courses; a single course cannot fulfill more than one major requirement.
requirements.name_zh: 高年级：数学-计算机综合选修（8 学分）
requirements.note_zh: 从应用数学/计算选修清单或所列课程中另修 8 学分；单门课不能同时满足两条专业要求。
